hero.label: Careers at Neryva
hero.title: Build intelligence that matters.
hero.description: We are looking for exceptional researchers, engineers, and operators who are driven to push the boundaries of physical AI. No bureaucracy. Just compute and autonomy.

items.title: Mission Absolute
items.description: We are anchored by a singular objective: building safe, frontier AI that transforms humanity. This mission isn't marketing—it is the lens through which every technical decision is evaluated.

items.title: Unconstrained Velocity
items.description: We eliminate bottlenecks. Every researcher and engineer is equipped with unrestricted access to massive compute clusters and the autonomy to test hypotheses at unprecedented speed.

items.title: High Trust, Low Ego
items.description: The best ideas survive through rigorous debate, not hierarchy. We foster a culture of radical candor where collaborative problem-solving trumps individual accolades.

items.title: Epistemic Rigor
items.description: We hold both the immense potential and the existential risks of AGI in focus. We operate with discipline, expecting teams to update their beliefs quickly when confronted with new data.

positions.title: Foundational AI Scientist
positions.description: Lead research on next-generation foundational models, focusing on scaling laws, novel architectures, and unsupervised learning.

positions.title: Sparse Architecture Researcher
positions.description: Design and implement sparse neural networks and mixture-of-experts architectures to maximize compute efficiency.

positions.title: Robotics Reinforcement Learning Lead
positions.description: Pioneer RL techniques for embodied AI, bridging the gap between simulation and real-world robotic deployment.

positions.title: Distributed Training Engineer
positions.description: Build the infrastructure to train multi-trillion parameter models across massive GPU clusters with high fault tolerance.

positions.title: Inference Optimization Lead (C++/CUDA)
positions.description: Optimize our frontier models for low-latency inference at scale using custom CUDA kernels and hardware-specific optimizations.

positions.title: Hardware Infrastructure Engineer
positions.description: Design and manage the physical network and compute infrastructure that powers our most ambitious training runs.

positions.title: Compute Cluster Manager
positions.description: Oversee the day-to-day operations, allocation, and health of our global high-performance computing clusters.

positions.title: Technical Recruiter
positions.description: Identify and engage with top-tier AI researchers and engineers, ensuring our talent density remains exceptional.
